verification_candidates.claim_text: Raising blood sugar and insulin while eating a high-fat diet causes triglycerides and VLDL cholesterol to rise sharply.

verification_candidates.rationale: Causal claim about combining high blood sugar/insulin with high dietary fat causing sharp lipid increases, checkable against metabolic research.
